reference_parity.activation_condition: Evaluate and require a pass only when a conforming externally produced frozen artifact is supplied.

report_status_policy.g0_completion_rule: Physics validation must pass. If a conforming independent artifact exists, reference parity must also pass; otherwise the report retains reference_parity=not_evaluated with its reason and G0 records that limitation. A later parity failure reopens G0 and invalidates dependent acceptance until reviewed.

source.producer: fixed legacy executable run outside DM-Transport
source.import_rule: Import an externally generated frozen artifact without recomputing expected values in DM-Transport.

target_selection_reference.distribution_implementation: Record the producer compiler and C++ standard-library identity.

conditioned_target_velocity.state_construction: Use the Cartesian product of radius, externally fixed target index, and positive speed ratio with the declared incoming direction.
conditioned_target_velocity.target_policy: The target index is an input to component comparisons; no target-selection draw occurs and selected_target_index is not reported.

full_chain.state_source: Use the Cartesian product of target_selection_reference.radius_Rsun and target_selection_reference.speed_over_c with the declared incoming direction.
full_chain.target_policy: Sample the target from all 63 source-order rates; never force a target index in a full-chain comparison.

collision_reference_parity.zero_speed_excluded_reason: The fixed legacy target-velocity sampler rejects non-positive incoming DM speed.

rng.distribution_implementation: Record the producer compiler and C++ standard-library identity.

collision_physics_validation.zero_speed_rule: Validate the analytic or one-sided collision-conditioned limit independently; do not request a zero-speed legacy sample.

common.bonferroni_family: All scalar acceptance checks across selected thermal-equilibrium weak functions, heating-cooling, full-chain rotation and CM scattering-angle CDFs in one full report.
common.bonferroni_z_rule: Use Phi^{-1}(1-(1-confidence_level)/(2*bonferroni_scalar_count)) for every gated scalar, including one-sided heating bounds, without reselecting the family after observing data.

smoke_override_policy.trigger: Any reduced sample count or state subset is diagnostic only.

common.holdout_policy: Pilot and full-run seeds must be disjoint. Freeze states, thresholds and acceptance rules before full independent-seed runs; do not tune against full-run outcomes.

canonical_source_policy.required_state: Each declared path is tracked and has no staged or unstaged differences from the recorded HEAD commit during the full run.
canonical_source_policy.sampler_build_requirement: Use the canonical project-local CMake target with clean tracked T03 build/physics sources and an executable newer than its compiled sources; custom or stale binaries are diagnostic only.

thermal_equilibrium.incoming_distribution: Maxwell-Boltzmann DM velocities at the local bath temperature; streaming disabled.
thermal_equilibrium.speed_bin_edge_rule: Lower-inclusive bins; null final upper edge means positive infinity. Finite edges are Maxwell-speed CDF quantiles 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 0.95.
thermal_equilibrium.gamma_reference: Gamma_total(r, sqrt(2*k_B*T_bath/m_chi)) evaluated once per radius
thermal_equilibrium.estimator: Mean of Y=(Gamma_total(r,|v_in|)/Gamma_reference)*(phi(v_out)-phi(v_in)); retain per-event or sufficient second moments for standard error.

full_chain_rotation.comparison: Apply inverse of the declared rotation to the rotated-run target and outgoing DM vectors; compare each Cartesian component CDF for both vectors and first and second moments for outgoing DM only. Do not require same-seed event equality.

cm_scattering_angle.observable: Cosine of the outgoing DM CM-frame direction against the incoming lab DM velocity axis, matching the legacy low-mass contact angle convention.
cm_scattering_angle.reference_cdf: F(x)=(x+1)/2 for isotropic low-mass contact scattering on [-1,1].

near_escape_tail.observable: P(|v_out|>v_escape(r)) after one local collision; this is not an evaporation rate.
near_escape_tail.ceiling_rule: Record exceedance only; never truncate collision sampling or treat this diagnostic as the T06 tail-error budget.

rng_prefix_environment_policy.standard_library_mismatch: Treat event prefixes as diagnostic and report exact prefix parity as not_evaluated; use aggregate statistical comparisons for acceptance.

comparison_policy.mean_interval: normal interval using 1.96 times the sample standard error
comparison_policy.histogram_interval: Wilson score interval per bin with Bonferroni correction across reported bins
comparison_policy.acceptance: Apply deterministic tolerances to scalar and event-prefix comparisons; require each producer-minus-project statistical difference to be consistent with zero under the declared combined uncertainty and multiple-comparison correction.

unavailable_reason: T01 contains no local background, direct-rate, or single-collision oracle values, and the read-only reference repository must not be built or run for this project.
